headline: Meta edits AI-scraping terms repeatedly amid backlash, then delays enforcement
summary: Meta's new business terms initially appeared to let it scrape content, including news sites, to train AI. After publisher backlash, Meta removed some of that language, but a spokesperson said its actual crawling had not changed, legal experts said scraping was still possible, and Meta ultimately delayed enforcement of the terms.
